method.fixed_aoi: Exact intersection with the same registered WGS84 bounding boxes used by ATLAS.
method.coverage_unit: Mask-chip pixels intersecting each fixed AOI. Counts may repeat across chips/events and are not deduplicated; not an AOI-wide coverage fraction.
method.label_interpretation: Source-coded mask values only; no value is assumed to mean independently verified floodwater without source-specific lineage review.
method.eligibility: Discovery only. DFO masks are automatic change-detection outputs. Neither source group is treated as confirmatory independent truth by this screen.

limitations: SenForFlood's published abstract describes 350+ events across continents, but this Hugging Face repository marks uploads as in progress; this audit reflects only the pinned repository revision, not necessarily the full Dataverse release.
A mask-chip intersection does not establish an event date, full AOI coverage, correct projection alignment to OPERA, license compatibility for redistribution, or independent pixel truth.

The DFO subset uses automatically generated masks. CEMS labels are analyst-created but require event, imagery-lineage, source-provenance, and spatial-coverage review before any independent reference use.
Per-chip pixel counts are repeated across temporal samples and must not be summed as unique area coverage.
